Description: Sudanese and East African home cooking in the heart of London
items_en:

Vegetable Molokhia - 11.90 - Jute leaf stew with garlic and coriander, served with rice
# Desserts
Basbousa - 4.90 - Semolina cake with syrup and coconut
Umm Ali - 5.90 - Warm pastry pudding with milk, nuts and raisins
# Drinks
Karkade - 3.20 - Chilled hibiscus with a hint of mint
Jebena Coffee - 3.80 - Spiced coffee with ginger and cardamom
Fresh Mango Juice - 3.90 - Pressed daily
